# Extract all valid rows from Table S6 (osimertinib group + other groups, 54 total)
table_s6 = get_rows("mmc2.pdf", "page40")
# Get additional pages for other groups (chemotherapy, dual-targeted, other targeted)
table_s6_page2 = get_rows("mmc2.pdf", "page41")
table_s6_page3 = get_rows("mmc2.pdf", "page42")

all_rows = table_s6 + table_s6_page2 + table_s6_page3

records = []
current_id = 0

# Process all rows to extract IC50, clinical response, consistency
for row_idx, row in enumerate(all_rows):
    # Look for rows with clinical response (PR/PD) and consistency (YES/NO)
    resp = None
    consistency = None
    ic50_ref = None
    resp_ref = None
    consistency_ref = None
    for col_idx, cell_val in enumerate(row):
        if cell_val in ("PR", "PD"):
            resp = cell_val
            resp_ref = cell_ref("mmc2.pdf", "page40" if row_idx < len(table_s6) else "page41" if row_idx < len(table_s6)+len(table_s6_page2) else "page42", row_idx + 1, col_idx + 1)
        if cell_val in ("YES", "NO"):
            consistency = cell_val
            consistency_ref = cell_ref("mmc2.pdf", "page40" if row_idx < len(table_s6) else "page41" if row_idx < len(table_s6)+len(table_s6_page2) else "page42", row_idx + 1, col_idx + 1)
        # Look for IC50 numeric value
        if isinstance(cell_val, str) and cell_val.replace(".", "", 1).isdigit():
            ic50_ref = cell_ref("mmc2.pdf", "page40" if row_idx < len(table_s6) else "page41" if row_idx < len(table_s6)+len(table_s6_page2) else "page42", row_idx + 1, col_idx + 1)
    if resp and consistency and ic50_ref:
        # Score: 1 = sensitive (LCO-DST matches clinical response YES), 0 = resistant (NO)
        score = {"ref": consistency_ref, "map": {"YES": 1, "NO": 0}}
        # Truth: 1 = PR (clinical response), 0 = PD
        truth = {"ref": resp_ref, "map": {"PR": 1, "PD": 0}}
        records.append({"id": f"LCO_{current_id}", "score": score, "truth": truth})
        current_id += 1
        if current_id >= 54:  # we need exactly 54 records
            break

print(f"Extracted {len(records)} records")

# Build final contract

        "patient_mapping": {"value": "individual_available", "evidence": ["article:p35", "mmc2.pdf/page40"], "explanation": "Individual LCO-DST and clinical response are linked for each unit in Table S6"},
        "regimen_match": {"value": "matched", "evidence": ["article:p35"], "explanation": "Clinical regimens were identical to LCO-DST test regimens for all included units"},
        "n_units": {"value": 54, "evidence": ["article:p35", "article:p101"], "explanation": "Total of 54 LCOs included in the accuracy analysis: 15+12+10+17 = 54"},
        "split": {"value": "same_cohort", "evidence": ["article:p35", "article:p102"], "explanation": "Analysis performed on a single real-world cohort, no independent test split"}
